_comment: 示例配置（非必需）：首次运行会自动生成 %APPDATA%\VSManager\settings.json；如需预置，可复制本文件到该位置后修改。以 _comment 开头的字段会被忽略。
_comment_secrets: AgentKeyProtected / VoiceKeyProtected / GitHubTokenProtected / WebToken 请保持空字符串，切勿填写明文。Key 可在「属性」中填写（DPAPI 加密保存，仅本机当前用户可解密），或改用环境变量 VSMANAGER_AGENT_API_KEY / VSMANAGER_DOUBAO_API_KEY / VSMANAGER_GITHUB_TOKEN；WebToken 为空时自动生成。
_comment_archive: ArchiveRoot 为空时依次使用环境变量 VSMANAGER_ARCHIVE_ROOT、%APPDATA%\VSManager\archive；支持 %环境变量% 写法。ArchiveRetentionDays 为 0 表示永久保留。
_comment_en: Example config (optional): %APPDATA%\VSManager\settings.json is created on first run; copy this file there only if you want to pre-seed it. Fields starting with _comment are ignored. Keep AgentKeyProtected / VoiceKeyProtected / GitHubTokenProtected / WebToken empty and never put plain-text secrets here: enter keys in Settings (DPAPI-encrypted) or use VSMANAGER_AGENT_API_KEY / VSMANAGER_DOUBAO_API_KEY / VSMANAGER_GITHUB_TOKEN. Empty ArchiveRoot falls back to VSMANAGER_ARCHIVE_ROOT, then %APPDATA%\VSManager\archive; ArchiveRetentionDays 0 keeps archives forever.
VoiceSpeaker: 年轻女声，普通话，语气轻快清晰
VoiceSpeakerEn: A young female voice speaking clear American English in a light, cheerful tone
